descriptions.w3d_d17a_command_create_800085fc: Allocates a 32-byte AI command (0x8001523c), runs its out-of-line constructor 0x80021514, appends the base pointer to the command storage at 0x804aa564 (growing it by half through 0x80212fd4/0x802eee50/0x802134fc when full), stores the float amount at +28 and registers the command with 0x8002274c on the registry 0x804aa5a4.
descriptions.w3d_d17a_command_create_8000889c: Allocates a 28-byte AI command (0x8001523c), runs its out-of-line constructor 0x80021768, appends the base pointer to the command storage at 0x804aa564, stores the float amount at +24 and registers the command with 0x8002274c on the registry 0x804aa5a4.
descriptions.w3d_d17a_command_create_16_80009014: Allocates a 28-byte type-16 AI command (table 0x8040dbc8, cleared link words), stores the int value at +20 and the float amount at +24, appends the base pointer to the command storage at 0x804aa564 and registers the command with 0x8002274c on the registry 0x804aa5a4.
